reels.name: reel-14-reel-robot
reels.topic: An AI pipeline makes Sujith's Instagram reel every morning: it reads 98 AI news sources, checks every number at the original source, writes the script, voices it in his cloned voice, animates every frame in code, gets reviewed by a second AI, and an AI replies to comments. About 34 minutes per reel; Sujith approves every post. Viewers were asked to comment ROBOT to get how it's built.

reels.name: reel-11-it-freshers
reels.topic: If AI does half the work in Indian IT, freshers are hit hardest: 3 AI models say fresher hiring falls 45-65% by 2030. What freshers should do: build with AI instead of competing on routine code, show real projects, aim for new roles in AI engineering, data and AI testing. Viewers were asked: fresher, or hiring them? Comment your plan.
